title: M5Stack Station-Bat · K124-B
summary: ESP32工业控制终端，配1.14英寸LCD、三个用户按键、六路Grove扩展与双18650并联电池供电。
assemblyNotes: Selected components already share assembled coordinates near X=0; only common center translation applied. Distant X components are printing-layout copies. Independent drawing gives 56x88mm main housing, 65mm including side rails, 92mm including rear hook, 35mm overall depth. Product specifications use 88x65x35, so distinct measurement scopes are retained without geometry fitting.
